summary: This standard covers companies that operate retail pharmacies and the distribution centres supplying them, selling prescription and over-the-counter medicines and other goods. Disclosure topics include energy management in stores, data security and privacy, drug supply chain integrity, management of controlled substances and patient health outcomes.

questions.text: What was your total energy consumed, and what percentage was (1) grid electricity and (2) renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total energy consumed in gigajoules, (2) the percentage from grid electricity and (3) the percentage from renewable sources.

questions.text: What policies and practices does your organisation have to secure customers' personal health data records and other personal data?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how you identify data security vulnerabilities and risks, the controls in place, and any standards or certifications followed.

questions.text: How many data breaches did you have, what percentage involved (a) personal data only and (b) personal health data, and how many customers were affected in each category?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) the number of breaches, (2) the percentage involving personal data only and personal health data, and (3) the number of customers affected in each category.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with data security and privacy?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: What efforts does your organisation make to reduce the occurrence of compromised drugs within the supply chain?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe supplier qualification, traceability, storage and handling controls, and verification measures used to prevent compromised drugs.

questions.text: How many drug recalls did you issue, how many units were recalled in total, and what percentage were private-label products?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) the number of recalls issued, (2) total units recalled and (3) the percentage of recalled units that were private-label products.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with controlled substances?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: What is your first fill adherence rate?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage of new prescriptions that patients pick up on the first fill, and state the calculation method and period.

questions.text: What policies and practices do you have to prevent prescription dispensing errors?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe procedures, technology, staffing and training measures, and how errors are tracked and reviewed.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with prescription dispensing errors?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: How many pharmacy locations do you operate?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of pharmacy locations at the end of the reporting period.

questions.text: What is the total area of your retail space in square metres?
questions.hint: Unit: Square metres (m²) · Report the total retail floor area in square metres at the end of the reporting period.

questions.text: How many prescriptions did you fill, and what percentage were for controlled substances?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) the number of prescriptions filled and (2) the percentage that were for controlled substances.

questions.text: How many pharmacists does your organisation employ?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of pharmacists at the end of the reporting period.
